desc.zh: 用两两合并与精确分数，穷尽四张牌的合法表达式。
desc.en: Reduce pairs with exact fractions to cover every legal four-card expression.

complexity: O(1) time and O(1) auxiliary space for exactly four bounded cards

concepts.name: Pair-reduction invariant
concepts.description: Disjoint subexpressions partition the original card identities.

concepts.name: Exact rational search
concepts.description: Fraction values avoid rounding tolerances in the four-card search.
